description: Adjust brightness, contrast, exposure (gamma), saturation, hue, and optional CLAHE on camera frames.

brightness.description: Brightness offset (-100..100). Attempts hardware acceleration; CPU fallback if unsupported.

contrast.description: Contrast multiplier (0.5..3.0). Attempts hardware acceleration; CPU fallback if unsupported.

exposure.description: Exposure control mapped to gamma (-2..2). Attempts hardware acceleration; CPU fallback if unsupported.

saturation.description: Saturation multiplier (0.0..2.0). Attempts hardware acceleration; CPU fallback if unsupported.

hue.description: Hue shift in degrees (-180..180). Attempts hardware acceleration; CPU fallback if unsupported.

enable_clahe.description: Enable CLAHE on luminance channel. WARNING: Always CPU-based, causes significant overhead.

clahe_clip_limit.description: CLAHE clip limit (1.0..40.0). Only used when enable_clahe=true. Higher values reduce CPU overhead but may over-enhance.
